$comment: BudgetMint's own project (budgetmint, .firebaserc): its Firestore rules (rules/firestore.rules) and its Hosting site, both deployed by BudgetMint's release. The CSP lets Google's tag (googletagmanager, google-analytics) in for usage analytics (apps/web/src/analytics.ts). firebase/firestore.rules is TaskMint's, pinned, for the tests only. The emulators are in firebase.emulators.json.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://apis.google.com https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.googletagmanager.com; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://firestore.googleapis.com https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://firebaseinstallations.googleapis.com https://firebase.googleapis.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://*.googletagmanager.com; frame-src 'self' https://budgetmint.firebaseapp.com https://taskmint-f9a05.firebaseapp.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
